title: Blog outline architect
prompt: Create a structured article outline for {topic} with audience, intent, examples, takeaways, and a clear call to action.

title: Launch announcement
prompt: Draft a product launch announcement for {feature}, leading with the problem, benefit, proof, and one next step.

title: Tone editor
prompt: Rewrite the supplied text in a confident, warm, direct voice while preserving facts and listing notable changes.

title: Landing page writer
prompt: Write landing-page copy for {product} with a concrete promise, supporting proof, objections, and focused call to action.

title: Newsletter curator
prompt: Turn these updates into a concise newsletter with a strong opening, grouped highlights, useful links, and closing question.

title: Case study builder
prompt: Create a customer case study covering context, challenge, approach, measurable outcome, quotation opportunities, and lessons learned.

title: Social campaign planner
prompt: Plan a two-week social campaign for {goal} with daily angles, channel adaptations, assets, and success measures.

title: Product description editor
prompt: Rewrite this product description around customer outcomes, concrete differentiators, usage context, and concise supporting details.

title: Video script writer
prompt: Draft a ninety-second video script for {topic} with a hook, visual beats, narration, proof, and memorable ending.

title: FAQ generator
prompt: Generate practical FAQs from this material, prioritizing buying questions, setup concerns, limitations, and brief direct answers.

title: SEO brief designer
prompt: Create a search-focused content brief for {keyword} with intent, structure, related questions, evidence needs, and differentiation.

title: Press release drafter
prompt: Draft a factual press release for {announcement} with headline, summary, context, quotations, details, and media contact placeholder.

title: Webinar abstract
prompt: Write a webinar abstract that defines the audience problem, learning outcomes, session flow, speaker value, and registration reason.

title: Brand voice guide
prompt: Derive a compact voice guide from these examples with principles, preferred language, avoided patterns, and before-after samples.

title: Executive summary
prompt: Condense this report into an executive summary covering the decision, evidence, implications, risks, and recommended action.

title: Release notes editor
prompt: Turn these changes into customer-friendly release notes organized by benefit, behavior change, migration need, and known limitation.

title: Podcast show notes
prompt: Create scannable show notes with episode thesis, key moments, named resources, timestamps, and a concise listener takeaway.

title: Ad variation generator
prompt: Generate ten distinct ad variations for {offer}, varying hook, proof, audience motivation, length, and call to action.

title: Content repurposer
prompt: Repurpose this long-form asset into an email, social thread, short post, checklist, and three quotation cards.

title: Editorial calendar planner
prompt: Build a monthly editorial calendar aligned to {goal}, balancing themes, formats, funnel stages, owners, and publication dates.

title: Pull request reviewer
prompt: Review this change for correctness, regressions, security, performance, and maintainability with actionable file-level findings.

title: Test case designer
prompt: Generate a compact test matrix for {feature} covering happy paths, boundaries, invalid input, concurrency, accessibility, and recovery.

title: Incident investigator
prompt: Analyze the supplied logs and timeline, separating observations from hypotheses and proposing fast checks for the likely failure chain.

title: API documentation writer
prompt: Document this API with purpose, authentication, parameters, realistic request, response shape, errors, and retry guidance.

title: Data query assistant
prompt: Translate this business question into safe readable SQL, stating grain and assumptions and adding validation queries.

title: Architecture decision recorder
prompt: Write an architecture decision record with context, constraints, options, chosen approach, consequences, and follow-up checks.

title: Bug reproduction writer
prompt: Convert this report into minimal deterministic reproduction steps with environment, expected result, actual result, and diagnostic evidence.

title: Refactoring planner
prompt: Plan a safe refactor for this module, identifying responsibilities, seams, incremental steps, compatibility risks, and regression coverage.

title: Security threat model
prompt: Threat-model this feature by listing assets, actors, trust boundaries, abuse cases, mitigations, and verification methods.

title: Performance profiler
prompt: Create a profiling plan for {system} with hypotheses, measurements, representative workloads, instrumentation, and decision thresholds.

title: Migration guide author
prompt: Write a migration guide that explains breaking changes, prerequisites, before-after examples, rollback, and validation steps.

title: Dependency upgrade reviewer
prompt: Assess this dependency upgrade for API changes, transitive risk, security impact, bundle cost, and required regression tests.

title: Accessibility auditor
prompt: Audit this interface for keyboard access, focus management, semantics, contrast, announcements, zoom, and motion preferences.

title: Observability designer
prompt: Design observability for this workflow with useful events, metrics, traces, correlation fields, alerts, and diagnostic dashboards.

title: Code explainer
prompt: Explain this code from public behavior inward, covering data flow, invariants, dependencies, failure modes, and safe extension points.

title: Commit message editor
prompt: Turn these changes into a concise commit message with imperative subject, motivation, key behavior, and relevant compatibility note.

title: Release risk assessor
prompt: Assess release risk using change surface, reversibility, data impact, dependencies, monitoring, rollout stages, and rollback readiness.

title: Frontend state debugger
prompt: Trace this UI state issue from event through store and render, identifying stale ownership, race conditions, and verification steps.

title: Backend contract reviewer
prompt: Review this service contract for validation, compatibility, idempotency, pagination, error semantics, timeouts, and operational safety.

title: Technical debt triager
prompt: Triage these debt items by user impact, failure risk, development drag, effort, dependencies, and the cost of delay.

title: Research brief
prompt: Produce a decision-ready brief on {topic}, summarizing evidence, disagreements, limitations, and sources behind each conclusion.

title: Interview synthesizer
prompt: Synthesize interview notes into recurring needs, pain points, workarounds, opportunities, evidence, and isolated observations.

title: Competitor comparison
prompt: Compare {products} across capabilities, setup, extensibility, support, cost, missing evidence, and scenario-based recommendations.

title: Survey designer
prompt: Design a concise unbiased survey for {question} with screening, balanced scales, open responses, and analysis guidance.

title: Literature review planner
prompt: Plan a literature review with research question, inclusion criteria, databases, search terms, quality checks, and synthesis method.

title: Market signal scanner
prompt: Organize these market signals into established changes, emerging patterns, weak signals, contradictions, and implications.

title: Persona evidence builder
prompt: Build an evidence-based persona from this research, distinguishing observed behavior from assumptions and identifying validation gaps.

title: Usability study planner
prompt: Create a usability study plan with goals, participant criteria, tasks, neutral prompts, success measures, and synthesis approach.

title: Source credibility checker
prompt: Evaluate these sources for authority, methodology, recency, incentives, corroboration, and appropriate confidence.

title: Experiment hypothesis writer
prompt: Turn this opportunity into a falsifiable hypothesis with audience, intervention, expected change, metric, guardrail, and duration.

title: Trend report editor
prompt: Transform these observations into a trend report separating durable shifts, seasonal noise, causal claims, and practical implications.

title: Customer journey researcher
prompt: Map the researched customer journey with goals, actions, evidence, friction, emotion, channels, and unanswered questions.

title: Pricing research guide
prompt: Create a pricing research guide that explores value, alternatives, budget process, willingness signals, and decision criteria without anchoring.

title: Opportunity mapper
prompt: Cluster this evidence into opportunity areas, affected users, frequency, severity, current alternatives, and confidence.

title: Evidence table builder
prompt: Build an evidence table with claim, supporting source, contradicting source, method quality, recency, and confidence.

title: Research question refiner
prompt: Refine this broad topic into answerable research questions with scope, definitions, assumptions, and suitable methods.

title: Focus group moderator
prompt: Write a neutral focus-group guide with warm-up, scenario prompts, probes, prioritization activity, and closing reflection.

title: Analytics insight narrator
prompt: Explain this analysis by stating the question, reliable finding, magnitude, uncertainty, plausible drivers, and next validation.

title: Benchmark study designer
prompt: Design a fair benchmark with representative tasks, baselines, environment controls, repeated runs, metrics, and reporting rules.

title: Research repository tagger
prompt: Create a practical taxonomy for these findings using topic, audience, journey stage, evidence type, confidence, and date.

title: Meeting action extractor
prompt: Turn these notes into decisions, open questions, and actions with owner, deliverable, due date, and dependency.

title: Weekly status update
prompt: Write a concise weekly update using outcomes, next priorities, risks, asks, and quantified progress where possible.

title: Process simplifier
prompt: Map this process into inputs, decisions, handoffs, outputs, delays, duplicates, and a smaller future-state workflow.

title: Decision memo
prompt: Write a one-page decision memo with context, options, criteria, recommendation, tradeoffs, risks, and reversible next step.

title: Project kickoff planner
prompt: Create a kickoff plan with objective, scope, roles, milestones, dependencies, communication rhythm, risks, and first decisions.

title: Risk register builder
prompt: Build a risk register with cause, event, impact, likelihood, owner, mitigation, trigger, and contingency.

title: SOP writer
prompt: Write a standard operating procedure with purpose, prerequisites, numbered steps, decision points, verification, escalation, and ownership.

title: Capacity planner
prompt: Create a capacity plan from demand, available effort, constraints, skills, priorities, buffers, and overload options.

title: Vendor evaluator
prompt: Build a vendor evaluation across requirements, implementation, security, support, cost, references, risks, and exit terms.

title: Retrospective facilitator
prompt: Design a focused retrospective that gathers evidence, identifies patterns, chooses improvements, assigns owners, and schedules follow-up.

title: Roadmap prioritizer
prompt: Prioritize these initiatives by strategic fit, user value, evidence, effort, dependency, risk, and cost of delay.

title: Handoff checklist builder
prompt: Create a handoff checklist covering context, current state, decisions, access, dependencies, risks, contacts, and acceptance.

title: Change communication planner
prompt: Plan change communication by audience, impact, message, channel, timing, feedback path, adoption signal, and owner.

title: OKR editor
prompt: Rewrite these goals as outcome-focused objectives with measurable key results, baselines, targets, owners, and guardrails.

title: Escalation summary
prompt: Create an escalation summary with impact, evidence, attempted actions, blocker, urgency, requested decision, and responsible contacts.

title: Budget narrative writer
prompt: Explain this budget through objectives, assumptions, major changes, expected return, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and approval needs.

title: Hiring scorecard
prompt: Create a role scorecard with outcomes, competencies, behavioral evidence, interview coverage, rating anchors, and decision rules.

title: Service review agenda
prompt: Build a service review around reliability, demand, incidents, customer feedback, capacity, commitments, and improvement owners.

title: Policy simplifier
prompt: Rewrite this policy in plain language while preserving obligations, exceptions, roles, enforcement, examples, and contact points.

title: Scenario response planner
prompt: Create response plans for best, expected, and adverse scenarios with triggers, decisions, owners, communications, and recovery criteria.

title: Socratic tutor
prompt: Teach {concept} through short adaptive questions, revealing one idea at a time and ending with practice and feedback.

title: Concept explainer
prompt: Explain {concept} at beginner, practitioner, and expert levels using one analogy, its limits, and a worked example.

title: Study plan builder
prompt: Create a four-week study plan for {skill} with weekly outcomes, practice, checkpoints, resources, and final project.

title: Quiz generator
prompt: Generate a progressive quiz on {topic} with recall, application, diagnosis, synthesis, answers, and explanations.

title: Practice coach
prompt: Design a deliberate-practice session for {skill} with warm-up, focused repetitions, feedback cues, difficulty progression, and reflection.

title: Learning objective writer
prompt: Write observable learning objectives for {course}, aligned to activities, assessment evidence, difficulty, and learner context.

title: Flashcard designer
prompt: Turn this material into concise flashcards that test one idea each, include retrieval cues, and avoid ambiguous wording.

title: Workshop facilitator
prompt: Plan an interactive workshop with outcomes, agenda, exercises, materials, facilitation prompts, timing, and transfer activity.

title: Misconception detector
prompt: Identify likely misconceptions about {topic}, explain why each is tempting, and create diagnostic questions and corrections.

title: Worked example writer
prompt: Create a worked example that makes each reasoning step explicit, checks understanding, and includes a faded-practice follow-up.

title: Reading guide creator
prompt: Create a reading guide with purpose, prerequisite concepts, guiding questions, key terms, checkpoints, and synthesis prompt.

title: Skill rubric builder
prompt: Build a skill rubric with clear levels, observable evidence, common errors, examples, and next-step feedback.

title: Course outline architect
prompt: Design a course sequence from learner starting point to target performance with modules, practice, assessment, and reinforcement.

title: Feedback translator
prompt: Turn this feedback into specific observations, likely impact, prioritized improvement actions, practice methods, and progress signals.

title: Memory aid inventor
prompt: Create memorable retrieval aids for these ideas using structure, imagery, contrast, examples, and spaced review prompts.

title: Peer review guide
prompt: Write a peer-review guide with criteria, evidence prompts, constructive language, rating anchors, and revision priorities.

title: Learning reflection coach
prompt: Guide a reflection on what changed, what remains uncertain, which strategies worked, and what to practice next.

title: Simulation scenario writer
prompt: Create a realistic simulation with context, constraints, decisions, branching consequences, observer notes, and debrief questions.

title: Certification prep planner
prompt: Build a certification preparation plan from exam domains, current gaps, available time, practice tests, review cycles, and readiness criteria.

title: Knowledge transfer planner
prompt: Plan knowledge transfer with essential concepts, demonstrations, guided practice, reference material, validation, and ongoing ownership.
